welcome.subject: Tukwanirizza mu Ochorus
welcome.preheader: Etterekero ekkakkamu ery’ebitabo by’Ekikristaayo eby’edda — bya bwereere, emirembe gyonna.
welcome.heading: Tukwanirizza mu Ochorus
paragraphs: Webale okwegatta ku Ochorus — etterekero ery’obwereere, eritaliimu matangaazo, ery’ebitabo by’Ekikristaayo eby’edda, mu lulimi lwo.

Buli kimu wano kyo okusoma: ebitabo ebinene ku kusaba, okwewaayo eri Katonda, n’obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’omunda, okuva ku Andrew Murray okutuuka ku Thomas à Kempis. Tewali ky’ogula, tewali kye weetaaga kuggulawo.
Engeri esinga obulungi ey’okutandika kwe kutandika butandisi okusoma. Londa ekitabo ekikusikiriza, oba leka entegeka y’okusoma ennyimpi ekutwale eddakiika ntono buli lunaku.

pick_plan.subject: Eddakiika ntono buli lunaku
pick_plan.preheader: Entegeka y’okusoma ennyimpi y’engeri esinga obwangu ey’okutandika.
pick_plan.heading: Zuula engeri yo ey’okusoma
paragraphs: Abasomi abasigala ne Ochorus kumpi bulijjo batandika mu ngeri y’emu — n’entegeka y’okusoma ennyimpi esaba eddakiika ntono zokka buli lunaku.
Entegeka ekutambuza mu kitabo eky’edda kitono kitono, okusoma ne kutakugwako ng’omugugu, n’empisa n’ekula yokka. Londa esaanira ekiseera ky’olimu kati.

finish_first_book.subject: Weeyongere we wakoma
finish_first_book.preheader: Ekitabo kyo ekisooka kikulindiridde — eddakiika ntono buli lunaku zikimaliriza.
finish_first_book.heading: Maliriza kye watandika
paragraphs: Watandika okusoma — eryo lye ddaala erisinga obuzibu, era olituuseeko dda. Ekitabo kye waggulawo kiterekeddwa we wakoma ddala.
Okumaliriza ekitabo kyo ekisooka kirina essanyu lyakyo ekkakkamu. Eddakiika ntono buli lunaku zokka ze weetaaga; ebirala tubikukolera — tukukuumira aw’otuuse.

classic.subject: Ekitabo eky’edda ekisaanira obudde bwo
classic.preheader: Abasomi ab’emyaka ebikumi tebayinza bonna kuba nga basobya.
classic.heading: Ekintu ekisaanira okusomebwa
paragraphs: Bw’oba tomanyi w’otandikira, tandikira ku kitabo ekiwangadde okusinga emisono gyonna — ekitabo eky’edda abasomi ab’emirembe mingi kye bazzeemu okusoma.

Bino bitabo bimpi, bya buziba, era bikyusa obulamu mu kasirise: Andrew Murray ku bwetoowaze, Brother Lawrence ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda, Thomas à Kempis ku kugoberera Kristo. Ggulawo kimu ekiro kya leero.

comeback.subject: Okusoma kwo kukulindiridde
comeback.heading: Komawo osome
paragraphs: Wayiseewo akaseera — era ekyo tekirina buzibu. Ebitabo bigumiikiriza, era buli kye watandika kiri ddala we wakireka.
Eddakiika ntono ez’akasirise zokka ze weetaaga okuddamu okutandika we wakoma. Aw’otuuse waterekeddwa era wakulindiridde buli lw’onoobeera mwetegefu.

winback.subject: Etterekero lyo likyaliwo
winback.preheader: Wayiseewo ebbanga — aw’otuuse twakukuumira, era byonna bikyali bya bwereere.
winback.heading: Twakukuumira aw’otuuse
paragraphs: Wayiseewo ebbanga bukyanga okyalira Ochorus, era ekyo tekirina buzibu — obulamu bujjudde emirimu. Twayagadde bwagazi omanye nti etterekero lyo likyaliwo, nga bwe walireka ddala.

Buli kimu kikyali kya bwereere, tekirimu matangaazo, era kikyali kikyo: ebitabo ebinene ku kusaba n’obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’omunda, mu lulimi lwo. Buli lw’onoofuna eddakiika ntono ez’akasirise, ekitabo ekirungi kikulindiridde.

finish_series.subject: Olugero lugenda mu maaso: {next}
finish_series.heading: Oli mwetegefu ku kiddako?
paragraphs: Omalirizza {finished} — tusuubira nti obudde bwo bwakozesebwa bulungi.
Kiri mu lunyiriri lw’ebitabo, era ekitabo ekiddako, {next}, kikwetegekedde buli lw’onoobeera mwetegefu. Ekitabo ekimu kikutwala mu kiddako.

plan_reminder.subject: Olunaku {day} · {plan}
plan_reminder.heading: {reading}
paragraphs: Olunaku {day} ku {total} mu {plan} lukwetegekedde.

plan_paused.subject: Aw’otuuse mu {plan} waterekeddwa
plan_paused.heading: Aw’otuuse waterekeddwa
paragraphs: Wakoma ku lunaku {day} mu {plan}. Tewali kukuyanguyiriza — kikyaliwo buli lw’onoobeera mwetegefu.
Tuyimirizza obujjukizo bwo obwa buli lunaku. Soma olunaku oluddako era bujja kuddamu okutandika.

milestone.subject: Ebitabo {count} — weebale nnyo
milestone.heading: Ebitabo {count} by’osomye
paragraphs: Kati omalirizza ebitabo {count} ku Ochorus — ogwo mutendera gwa ddala, era gusaanira okuyimirira akaseera okugujaguza.
Buli kimu ku byo kitabo kya dda ekinywezezza era ne kizuukusa abasomi okumala emirembe n’emirembe, era okisomye okukimaliriza. Tukwagaliza ekiddako, buli lw’onoobeera mwetegefu.
